_comment: Seed word-translation demo for the 'how to say?' command's
instructions-panel illustration, one entry per language code in
android SupportedLanguages.ALL. Each language has a `language_display`
string and one `example` with the same fixed English source word
('sleepy') plus its translation, so the app can show a live
'sleepy -> <word>' arrow demo without calling on-device translation
just to render a static instructions panel.
Only the Russian entry is battle-tested (matches the reference
design). The rest are reasonable single-word translations, NOT
verified by a native speaker yet -- same caveat as
